name: Philosophical Spellcasting
body:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic spellcasting class feature

Benefit(s): You use your Wisdom instead of your Charisma to learn, prepare, and cast spells, and when determining their bonus spell slots from high ability scores with your bardic spellcasting ability.
